Core.clearance(z,x,zc)local rx,rz=x-z.cx,zc-z.cz if z.kind==_a(84)then return math.sqrt(rx*rx+rz*rz)-z.r end local du=math.abs(rx*z.ux+rz*z.uz)-z.hu local dv=math.abs(rx*z.vx+rz*z.vz)-z.hv if du>dv then return du end return dv end function Core.depth(z,x,zc,dt)local c local mvx=z.mvx if mvx and dt and dt>(7345-7345)then if dt>2.4 then dt=2.4 end c=Core.clearance(z,x-mvx*dt,zc-(z.mvz or(8442-8442))*dt)else c=Core.clearance(z,x,zc)end local g=(z.pad or(-3126+3129))-c if g>(-8761+8761)then return g end return(-6732+6732)end function Core.median(list)local n=#list local c={}for i=(7060-7059),n do c[i]=list[i]end table.sort(c)if n%(-7376+7378)==(7964-7963)then return c[(n+(7582-7581))/(7566-7564)]end return(c[n/(9934-9932)]+c[n/(5720-5718)+(-8788+8789)])/(-6797+6799)end function Core.teleDefault(name)local n=string.lower(tostring(name or""))local best,bl=nil,(-9688+9688)for k,v in pairs(Core.tele)do if#k>bl and string.find(n,k,(7487-7486),true)then best=v bl=#k end end return best end function Core.teleSane(name,v)if not Core.fin(v)or v<0.3 or v>(-1459+1467)then return false end local d=Core.teleDefault(name)if d and(v<d*0.5 or v>d*1.8)then return false end return true end function Core.teleFor(name)local n=string.lower(tostring(name or""))local d=Core.teleDefault(n)local L=Core.learned[n]if L and#L>(-6051+6051)and(not d or#L>=(-3147+3150))then local m=Core.median(L)if Core.teleSane(n,m)then return m,true end end if d then return d,true end return Core.cfg.DefaultTele,false end function Core.learn(name,life)local n=string.lower(tostring(name or""))if not Core.teleSane(n,life)then return(Core.teleFor(n))end local L=Core.learned[n]if not L then L={}Core.learned[n]=L end L[#L+(-6997+6998)]=life if#L>(-6732+6741)then table.remove(L,(-7481+7482))end return Core.median(L)end function Core.teleDump()local out={}for k,L in pairs(Core.learned)do local c={}for i=(3199-3198),#L do c[i]=L[i]end out[k]=c end return out end function Core.teleLoad(t)if type(t)~=_a(74)then return end for k,L in pairs(t)do if type(k)==_a(85)and type(L)==_a(74)then local c={}for i=(5075-5074),#L do local v=L[i]if Core.teleSane(k,v)and#c<(1311-1302)then c[#c+(-7761+7762)]=v end end if#c>(3769-3769)then Core.learned[string.lower(k)]=c end end end end function Core.isFam(name)return string.find(string.lower(tostring(name or"")),_a(86),(2256-2255),true)~=nil end function Core.armFor(name)local n=string.lower(tostring(name or""))if string.find(n,_a(86),(3668-3667),true)then return 0.65 end if string.find(n,_a(87),(-2987+2988),true)then return 0.6 end return Core.cfg.ArmFrac end function Core.window(z,now)if z.w0 and z.w1 then return z.w0,z.w1 end local hit=Core.cfg.Hit local born=z.born or now local rem=z.removed local fam=Core.isFam(z.name)if z.cut and not fam and(not rem or z.cut<rem)then rem=z.cut end local mvz=z.mvz or(-6708+6708)if z.mvx~=nil and(z.mvx~=(2209-2209)or mvz~=(-5602+5602))then if rem then return born,rem+hit end return born,now+(-2888+2891)end local T,known=Core.teleFor(z.name)local t0=born if known then t0=born+Core.armFor(z.name)*T end if fam then local floorEnd=born+2.3 if rem then return t0,math.max(rem+hit,floorEnd)end return t0,math.max(born+T+hit+0.35,floorEnd)end if rem then return t0,rem+hit end return t0,born+T+hit+0.35 end function Core.mobSpeed(m)local s=m and m.speed if not Core.fin(s)then return(-6228+6246)end if s<(6373-6365)then return(4056-4048)end if s>(2980-2940)then return(-353+393)end return s end function Core.mobAt(m,t,bx,bz)local sp=Core.mobSpeed(m)local x,z=m.x,m.z local dx,dz=bx-x,bz-z local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)local room=d-(4929-4926)if room<=(-4357+4357)or d<0.001 then return x,z end local run=sp*t if run>room then run=room end return x+dx/d*run,z+dz/d*run end function Core.mapNew()return{cells={},last=(586-586)}end function Core.mapKey(ix,iz)return(ix+(2222+2778))*(16079-6079)+(iz+(14141-9141))end function Core.mapSet(map,ix,iz,v,now)local key=Core.mapKey(ix,iz)local c=map.cells[key]if c then c.v=v c.t=now else map.cells[key]={v=v,t=now,ix=ix,iz=iz}end end function Core.mapMark(map,x,z,now)if not(map and Core.fin(x)and Core.fin(z))then return end Core.mapSet(map,math.floor(x/(7005-7001)),math.floor(z/(-6868+6872)),(-9781+9782),now)end function Core.mapObserve(map,px,pz,dists,n,maxd,now)if not(map and Core.fin(px)and Core.fin(pz))then return end local step=(-612+614)*math.pi/n for i=(5941-5940),n do local d=dists[i]if Core.fin(d)then local a=(i-(-1487+1488))*step local ca,sa=math.cos(a),math.sin(a)local blocked=d<maxd-0.5 local now-c.t>(8168-8148)then map.cells[key]=nil end end end end function Core.mapBlocked(map,x,z,now)if not map then return(-9245+9245)end local c=map.cells[Core.mapKey(math.floor(x/(3567-3563)),math.floor(z/(6985-6981)))]if not c or c.v==(1675-1675)then return(3387-3387)end local age=now-c.t if age<=(-7600+7614)then return(6152-6151)end if age>=(4517-4497)then return(-5586+5586)end return((-2513+2533)-age)/(-3149+3155)end function Core.offsets(rad)local K=math.floor(rad+1e-9)local ox,oz,ol,n={},{},{},(-1392+1392)for dx=-K,K do for dz=-K,K do local len=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)if len<=rad+1e-9 then n=n+(-7068+7069)ox[n]=dx oz[n]=dz ol[n]=len end end end return{ox=ox,oz=oz,ol=ol,n=n,K=K}end function Core.raster(z,cx,cz,pad,px,pz,N,W)local B,cfg=Core.buf,Core.cfg local ci,cc,cd=B.ci,B.cc,B.cd local CS,Pen,Soft=cfg.CS,cfg.Pen,cfg.Soft local sqrt,abs=math.sqrt,math.abs local reach=pad+Soft local circle=z.kind==_a(84)local ex,ez if circle then ex=z.r+reach ez=ex else ex=abs(z.ux)*z.hu+abs(z.vx)*z.hv+reach ez=abs(z.uz)*z.hu+abs(z.vz)*z.hv+reach end local ix0=math.max(-N,math.ceil((cx-ex-px)/CS))local ix1=math.min(N,math.floor((cx+ex-px)/CS))local iz0=math.max(-N,math.ceil((cz-ez-pz)/CS))local iz1=math.min(N,math.floor((cz+ez-pz)/CS))if ix0>ix1 or iz0>iz1 then return(-856+856)end local n=(2211-2211)for iz=iz0,iz1 do local rz=pz+iz*CS-cz local base=(iz+N)*W+N+(-6519+6520)for ix=ix0,ix1 do local rx=px+ix*CS-cx local c if circle then c=sqrt(rx*rx+rz*rz)-z.r else local du=abs(rx*z.ux+rz*z.uz)-z.hu local dv=abs(rx*z.vx+rz*z.vz)-z.hv c=du>dv and du or dv end local g=pad-c if g>(7581-7581)then n=n+(2075-2074)ci[n]=base+ix cd[n]=g cc[n]=Pen*((-2547+2548)+g/(872-868))elseif g>-Soft then n=n+(1593-1592)ci[n]=base+ix cd[n]=(-8680+8680)cc[n]=0.4*((2231-2230)+g/Soft)end end end return n end function Core.plan(inp)local return pos+best*math.max((-6437+6441),math.min(bestD-1.5,(7542-7532)))end function Mover.step(hum,hrp)local goal=Mover.goal if not goal then return nil end local pos=hrp.Position local Mover.wi=Mover.wi+(-2167+2168)wp=wps[Mover.wi]end if wp then if wp.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then hum.Jump=true end hum:MoveTo(wp.Position)else hum:MoveTo(goal)end if now-Mover.lastT>=0.8
